name: DPP record version 3: a carried passport lineage, its token id, control, retirement and the refusals

vectors.description: Genesis: ISSUE by the issuer carried as a fixed-supply BRC-162 deploy of one unit at output 0 (prefix OP_0 OP_1 OP_2DROP), the controller key being the issuer account's per-passport child under [1, 'dpp owner v1'], locked to the custodian. The token id is this outpoint (spec token-carrier.md sections 2 to 6).
UPDATE by the issuer account changing the payload, carried as a value output naming the genesis as its token id: predecessor outpoint and lineage genesis bound, control proved by linkage.

TRANSFER by the issuer account to the recipient's controller key, the carrier output at index 1 behind an OP_RETURN so a value output away from index 0 is tested rather than assumed; control proved by linkage.
UPDATE by the recipient acting under the controller key itself: the equality form of control, field 14 empty.

RETIRE by the recipient account, control proved by linkage, event_data carrying the reason: a value output of one unit that nothing may spend; to a token reader the unit is live, to a passport reader the lineage is ended.
The token id of the lineage: the genesis outpoint, written on the wire as the deploy txid in internal byte order with the index implied, and displayed as the txid in display order followed by _0.
The issuer account's controller key for the passport and the scalar that proves the account derived it.
The recipient account's controller key and scalar, the destination the TRANSFER moves control to.

Verify the five raw transactions genesis to tip from hex alone: every state decodes from behind its prefix, the genesis is a deploy at output 0, every later state is a value output naming the genesis, every actor signature verifies under the version 3 protocol, every link holds with control proven, and the publisher signatures verify under the custodian key.
The genesis behind an OP_RETURN, at output 1.

expected.reason: a genesis is a deploy at output 0

vectors.description: A genesis body behind a value prefix naming a token id. A generic reader of the token protocol accepts this output; the refusal is the carrier's own rule.

expected.reason: a genesis carries an empty token id

vectors.description: A state after genesis behind a deploy prefix. A generic reader of the token protocol accepts this output; the refusal is the carrier's own rule.

expected.reason: a state after genesis carries the lineage token id

vectors.description: A value output naming another deploy as its token id. A generic reader of the token protocol accepts this output; the refusal is the carrier's own rule.

expected.reason: the token id names the lineage genesis

vectors.description: The token id written in display byte order: another token to every reader. A generic reader of the token protocol accepts this output; the refusal is the carrier's own rule.

expected.reason: the token id names the lineage genesis

vectors.description: A version 2 body, signed under the version 2 protocol, behind the prefix: no DPP output to this reader.

expected.reason: exactly one DPP output required, found 0

vectors.description: A version 3 body with no prefix.

expected.reason: exactly one DPP output required, found 0

vectors.description: A version 3 body whose signatures were made under the version 2 protocol and tags.
An UPDATE spending the RETIRE.

expected.reason: the lineage is retired: no state may follow RETIRE

vectors.description: Two value outputs of the token in one transaction.

expected.reason: exactly one DPP output required, found 2

vectors.description: A stranger spending the tip with no control proof.

expected.reason: the actor is not the controller and control_linkage is empty

vectors.description: A second ISSUE, as a value output, spending the genesis.

expected.reason: ISSUE is allowed at genesis only

vectors.description: The tip after state 1 spent by a transaction with no carrier output. A token reader records a burn; a passport reader finds no state in the transaction, reports the lineage as ended without a RETIRE and the tip as spent.

expected.reason: exactly one DPP output required, found 0
